method.acceptance: Each of three primary cases: >=15% paired median wall and CPU reduction and >=7/8 favorable pairs; each of three controls: <=5% paired median regression. Final native claim requires all six cases, >=8 pairs, and every observed sample >=250ms.
method.calibration: Both variants warm up, then matched pilots select one count with a 1.5x duration margin targeting at least target-ms in the faster variant; verification pilots retained. Observed samples below target are retained, never retried or discarded.
method.sampling: Fresh processes, same iteration count for both variants, balanced AB/BA pairs, rotating workload order; every sample retained.
method.scope: Complete SourceMediaPresenceCursor traversal of warm generated local filesystems; no file-content decoding, scanner pacing sleeps, UI rendering, or energy measurement.
method.sources: Complete production scanner plus unchanged dependencies; real Foundation/Observation, separate Swift modules, no cross-module optimization.
method.tests: Same complete reuse, recomputation, and traversal regression suites in baseline/candidate, debug/release; complete filesystem oracle receipts compared across all four executables.
method.timing: Harness monotonic wall and process CPU clocks; fixture creation and receipt verification outside timing; no empty-loop subtraction.
